boundary: The checked-in dependency gate covers the enabled Rust feature graph for macOS development and Linux deployment plus both npm lockfiles. It blocks known Rust advisories, unapproved dependency licenses and sources, and moderate-or-higher npm advisories. A reviewed exception is not evidence that a dependency is safe forever.

exceptions.scope: Compile-time macro used transitively by rav1e 0.8.1 through ravif for AVIF encoding.
exceptions.reason: No maintained rav1e release or safe upgrade currently removes paste; this exception does not cover runtime vulnerabilities or a different dependency path.
exceptions.remove_when: Upgrade or replace rav1e/ravif as soon as a maintained release removes paste, then delete this exception in the same change.
